## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit test, or a case in `tests/e2e/`)
- [ ] User-facing change: `--help`, README and `CHANGELOG.md` ("Unreleased") are updated
- [ ] No command, flag or output field is removed or renamed (or the description says so)
